name: Kestrel Foods synthetic case-competition dataset
domain: Fictional business case competition (packaged-snacks maker 'Kestrel Foods Ltd.')
data_compliance: Fully synthetic: fictional company, teams and figures. External-copy passages are quoted from pinned pre-ChatGPT Wikipedia revisions (CC BY-SA 4.0, see reference_corpus/manifest.json). No real student data, no proprietary or copyrighted case material.
provenance: All texts were drafted with AI assistance for this assessment. 'ai_generated' = unedited default-style LLM output from a plain instruction. 'human_style' = written to emulate student writing. Because human_style files are not genuinely human-authored, AI detection is evaluated primarily on benchmarks/ai_detection (genuinely human pre-2022 Wikipedia vs LLM text). Speech was synthesised with offline Windows SAPI voices (David, Zira).
